answer_1.quote: Given a source language sentence s and a human-generated translation t, the goal of TEC is to produce a corrected target language sentence t ′.

answer_2.quote: The primary metric for TEC is MaxMatch scores (M 2 ) (Dahlmeier and Ng, 2012) computed with the errant toolkit.

answer_4.quote: we performed a human-in-the-loop user study with our TEC model. We recruited 9 professional translators to serve as reviewers.
answer_4.guideline: reviewers were asked to accept or reject each of the suggestions, then make edits until satisfied; a 10th translator ranked the quality of reviewed translations
